title: SHA breaks ground on 125-unit senior complex at East Adams
summary: Syracuse Housing Authority held a groundbreaking for a 125-unit senior housing complex at East Adams and named the building after Bill Simmons, the agency's longtime executive director who departed in summer 2026 following a turbulent year marked by internal board division.
